'''Skytowers Residence''' was an ancient apartment block located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Brenn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genesia]]. An apartment on the 42nd floor served as a safehouse for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Equa Felens]].
